headword: {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}

definitions.explanation: The offense of parking a vehicle in a prohibited area or exceeding the permitted parking time. A very common traffic violation in Japan.

examples.japanese: {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}で{切符|きっぷ}を{切|き}られた。
examples.english: I got a ticket for a parking violation.

examples.japanese: ここに{止|と}めたら{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}になるよ。
examples.english: If you park here, it'll be a parking violation.

examples.japanese: {都心部|としんぶ}では{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まりが{厳|きび}しくなっている。
examples.english: Enforcement of parking violations has become stricter in the city center.

notes:
A compound of {駐車|ちゅうしゃ} (parking) + {違反|いはん} (violation). One of the most common traffic violations in Japan. Since 2006, private parking enforcement officers ({駐車監視員|ちゅうしゃかんしいん}) patrol many urban areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}で{切符|きっぷ}を{切|き}られる: to get a parking ticket
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり: enforcement of parking violations
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}の{反則金|はんそくきん}: parking violation fine
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}シール: parking violation sticker (placed on windshield)

RELATED TERMS:
- {路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}: on-street parking
- {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}: illegal parking (synonym)
- {駐車禁止|ちゅうしゃきんし}: no parking
- {反則金|はんそくきん}: traffic fine
- {違反切符|いはんきっぷ}: traffic ticket
